title: Hermes Agent Replaces Monthly Credit Blocks With New Daily and Weekly Usage Limits
summary:
Nous Research has updated the pricing structure for its Hermes AI assistant, introducing new subscription plans that go live Oct 27. The revamped tiers replace the previous system of one monthly block of credits with usage caps that reset on daily and weekly cycles, and provide all new subscribers with a pre-provisioned cloud instance of the agent.

The updates follow the launch of an integration with Meshy, a plugin that allows the agent to generate, texture, rig, and animate 3D models from text or images. To support the rollout, Meshy is offering a one-month subscription to its Pro tier for $1, which includes API access and 1,000 credits.

We've revamped Hermes Agent subscriptions. 

Every new plan now includes a cloud agent out of the box, and usage has daily and weekly limits instead of one monthly block of credits.

Subscribers can switch to the new plans any time at https://t.co/hsnPi9hDPn https://t.co/t4fl3FrxQv

selectedTweets.bestBit: Ask Hermes to make a 70m poly treasure chest for Godot, or to turn a photo of a mug into a model you can print
selectedTweets.text:
Hermes Agent now has an official plugin for @MeshyAI. 

Ask Hermes to make a 70m poly treasure chest for Godot, or to turn a photo of a mug into a model you can print, and it does the job through Meshy's MCP server. 

In Hermes Desktop the models render in chat, rigged characters animate inline, and a gallery stores every model and prompt. On messaging apps, Hermes sends a short preview video so you can create on the go.

https://t.co/QlxZUDEBn3
